name: Hobo-san Chu!
source:
Kasuga Shin’ichi works at the Kazamizawa Daycare Center. Together with Osamura Natsumi and other daycare workers, their daily routine resumes itself to taking care of and supervising the growth of multiple children.

One day, the cute and lively Shima Chiaki joins them as a new daycare worker. However, she ends up causing lots of problems as she can’t get used to the various tasks related to taking care of the children’s needs.

As her senior on the job, Shin’ichi is instructed to put into practice a special curriculum, which they came to mention as “night training”. Witnessing Chiaki in low spirits over not being able to perform at her dream job, he steels his heart in order to turn her into a proper daycare worker.

[From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
translation:
春日真一在风见泽托儿所工作。他与刑部夏海及其他保育员每天的工作，就是照料许多孩子，守护他们成长。

一天，可爱活泼的志摩千秋作为新保育员加入众人。然而，她始终无法适应照顾孩子所需的各种工作，因此惹出了许多麻烦。

作为职场前辈，真一受命为她实施一套特殊课程，众人称之为"夜间训练"。看到千秋因为无法胜任梦想中的工作而情绪低落，他硬起心肠，决心把她培养成一名合格的保育员。

[摘自[url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
